items.text: Kai kuma, da wannan salon maganar ka na bura, sunan ka ya kamata ya kasance Alain Buralon.
items.q: 'Alain Buralon' is meant as a rude pun on the actor Alain Delon. Would Hausa readers get it? If not, what word could carry it?
before: – I, Hamoun suna ne mai kyau a gare ka. Kamar Hamoun a cikin fim, kai ma cike ka da tambayoyi. Cike ka da damuwa kuma tushen firgici ne, ba a gare ka ba amma a gare ni.

items.text: Ruwan sama ba ya sauka sama daga ƙasa.
items.q: Her son says he would die for her; Maman objects. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Hannuna gajere ne haɗuwa da ke kuma nesa.
items.q: Amir tells the girl he loves why he holds back. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Ina cewa in dai haka kana zaune nan kana karanta waƙa kawai, ba wani burodi da zai dafu maka.
items.q: A friend criticises Amir for reading poetry all day. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Bibi, Allah ya yi mata rahama, sukan ce a irin waɗannan lokuta: idan na faɗa shi, harshena yana ƙonewa; idan ban faɗa ba, ƙashin kasusuwan na yana ƙonewa.
items.q: Maman hesitates before criticising her husband. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Yana cewa, "Ana san shekara mai kyau daga kaskawar ta."
items.q: The family's New Year visits were cancelled; a brother jokes about it. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: – Abokin ɗan uwan ustaz ɗin sana'ar surukinmu, wanda shi ne mutumin da ya fi kowa arziki a Tehran, shi ya gaya masa.
items.q: Is it clear the master craftsman is the one our brother-in-law works under?
before: – Mayar mini. Sai ka ce ya san yadda masu wayoyi suke aiki.
Taghi ya kama hannun Hamid a sararin sama ya ceci walkman. Amma Yaser ya sami 'yan dūka da harbi. Hamid ya ce:

items.text: Ka fita ma. Ka je inda babu mutane da yawa.
items.q: During Covid, Maman tells her son abroad not to stay home all the time, but to avoid crowds. Does this sound natural from a mother?
before: – A'a, kar ki damu. Nan za mu iya ma yin odar kayan masarufi sai su kawo su gaban kofa namu.
– Oh, kyau sosai. Mm-hm, oda su kawo maka. Amma Amir-jan, kar ka zauna a gida koyaushe.

items.text: – In kana tunanin ka ɗauki wannan mota tare da kai — ka sake tunani.
items.q: Taghi is saying yes to the fight, on one condition. Is that clear?
before: Motar tana hannuna amma ba mu iya gudu ba — Negar tana tsaye tana kallonmu. Taghi ya ce:
